class.name: EquipmentActorToSpawn
class.brief_description: A scene shown on the character while a piece of equipment is on.
class.description: The axe in the hand, the backpack on the back. Purely visual and local: every peer the equipment replicates to instantiates its own copy, so the scene must not be a networked node.

members.member: When set, the scene follows this bone of the first [Skeleton3D] found at or below [member attach_to], through a [BoneAttachment3D] created for it - so a skeleton built at runtime needs no fixed path.
Relative to the pawn root; empty means the pawn root itself.
The scene's local transform under its parent. A [Node2D] scene takes the origin's x and y.
